releases.name: MBN Instrument 2.1.0-rc.6 — Windows, macOS and USB Firmware Update
releases.body:
macOS rc.6 and F4 firmware USB update release.

- Fixes the Qt crash during firmware update completion: a modal progress update could process completion events that closed the dialog before it was accessed again.
- Adds **Reinstall firmware** over USB when the installed and published firmware versions match. Newer firmware still uses **Update firmware**; bootloader/capacity checks remain enforced.
- The USB firmware action is available alongside ST-Link installation. Only the instrument restarts after flashing; the desktop application stays open.
- macOS application: **2.1.0-rc.6**, Sparkle build **3**. The signed macOS update channel supports automatic installation and incremental updates from prior builds.
- Included F4 USB firmware: **2.1.1**; requires USB bootloader **1.0.0** installed previously through ST-Link. Firmware assets are unchanged from the earlier rc.6 firmware release.

Use **Check Updates → Update software** in rc.5 to install the desktop fix. Afterward, **Check Updates → Update firmware / Reinstall firmware** installs the published firmware through USB.

Validation: 18 firmware updater tests, including the modal completion crash regression and same-version reinstall selection; 30 control-flow tests (two optional live-network tests skipped); macOS build, deployed bundle signing and DMG verification. Physical USB reflashing remains to be confirmed on the instrument.

Windows x64 2.1.0-rc.6 is now available alongside the macOS application and F4 USB firmware.

## Windows x64 rc.6

- Includes the firmware-update completion crash fix and USB firmware reinstallation when installed/published versions match. USB and ST-Link actions are offered together; firmware installation restarts the instrument while keeping the desktop application open.
- Includes Qt runtimes, ST-Link 1.8.0 tools, libusb, chip definitions and licenses. Install the ST-Link USB driver separately from https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/stsw-link009.html.
- Windows validation: six QtTest suites, 124 passed, 0 failed. The two Windows live network cases were then run successfully: rc.6 update selection and public installer download/checksum verification passed. The POSIX-only mock CLI fixture remains skipped. The rc.6 published 2.1.1 firmware package passed package validation. Deployed app version is 2.1.0-rc.6; installer version is 2.1.0.6; bundled ST-Link tools report 1.8.0.
- Physical USB/ST-Link programming remains unverified in this Windows run.

Download center: https://man-mbn.github.io/MBN-Instrument-Releases/

releases.name: MBN Instrument 2.1.0-rc.5 — Windows and macOS ST-Link Preview
releases.body:
Download center: https://man-mbn.github.io/MBN-Instrument-Releases/

macOS preview 2.1.0-rc.5 — ST-Link firmware installation

Apple Silicon (arm64); requires macOS 27.0 or newer. Development ad-hoc signature; not Apple notarized.

- Interactive Check Updates detects a connected ST-Link target and offers Install firmware via ST-Link, in preference to USB firmware installation when a supported probe and release are available.
- Downloads the latest matching factory HEX directly from GitHub, verifies SHA-256, Intel HEX bounds/checksums and factory image metadata before writing.
- Pins the probe serial, requires supported STM32F405/F407 chip family with 1 MB flash, reads every programmed segment back for byte comparison, then resets the target.
- Recording, pending instrument commands and concurrent update operations prevent installation. A connected instrument must confirm STOP. Checking updates alone never writes firmware.
- Includes stlink 1.8.0, libusb, chip definitions and licenses; no Homebrew installation needed on macOS.
- Signed Sparkle rc.4-to-rc.5 delta upgrade; no dragging after the first installation. Windows x64 rc.5 is now available in MBN-Instrument-Setup.exe with its SHA-256 sidecar.

The attached STM32F407VG-MBN 2.1.0 development factory HEX installs the USB bootloader and application. The .mbnfw package is for boards already running a compatible USB bootloader. The probe chip ID cannot identify the board design: confirm the attached board is the intended MBN STM32F407VG. ST-Link cannot reliably report the version of arbitrary legacy firmware, so the app explicitly offers installation/reinstallation rather than claiming the board is current.

Validation: mocked programming/readback/error cases, generated firmware/package checks, real signed rc.4-to-rc.5 delta reconstruction and native app/tool/feed checks passed. Physical ST-Link/USB programming of this development firmware remains unverified. Use a bench setup with external excitation stopped and keep board power/SWD connected. The unsigned development firmware provides integrity checks, not publisher signature authentication. Settings flash above 0x080C0000 is excluded from the factory HEX and programming bounds.

## Windows x64 rc.5

- Includes the rc.5 ST-Link firmware installation flow, release manifest and SHA-256 validation, bounded Intel HEX checks, pinned probe selection and byte-for-byte readback before reset.
- Bundles official ST-Link 1.8.0 x64 tools, libusb 1.0.29, relocated chip definitions and licenses. A compatible Windows USB driver for the probe must be installed separately.
- Includes the existing USB firmware updater and verified Windows software updater. Use Check Updates in older Windows versions to install rc.5.
- Windows validation: 119 QtTest cases passed, no failures; one POSIX-only mock fixture remains skipped. The two live Windows network checks were then run successfully, verifying rc.5 update selection and the public installer download against its SHA-256 sidecar. Generated factory HEX and firmware package checks passed. Deployed application reports 2.1.0-rc.5; installer version is 2.1.0.5. Both bundled native CLI tools start and no-probe detection succeeds.
- Physical ST-Link/USB programming remains unverified. No connected board was programmed during Windows validation.

releases.name: MBN Instrument 2.1.0-rc.4 — macOS Preview
releases.body:
macOS preview release: 2.1.0-rc.4

- Apple Silicon (arm64); requires macOS 27.0 or newer for this build.
- Bundled Qt runtime and application icon.
- Check Updates checks host software and instrument firmware separately.
- Signed Sparkle incremental software updates with full-package fallback, automatic replacement and relaunch after the instrument safely stops. First installation/migration uses the DMG.
- USB firmware-update integration is included; the complete update sequence on a physical STM32 board has not yet been verified. This release does not contain a new firmware image.

Development build: ad-hoc signed, not Apple notarized. macOS Gatekeeper may display a security warning.

Open the DMG, install MBN_Instrument_Mac.app in Applications, eject the image and launch the installed app. Subsequent supported software updates install from within the app without dragging.

Windows rc.4 has not been built or published. Existing Windows rc.3 assets remain available in their original release.

releases.name: MBN Instrument v2.1.0-rc.1
releases.body:
Initial automatic-update release for the Qt/F4 application.

- Checks this public repository automatically at startup and manually from Help > Check for updates.
- Downloads over Windows HTTPS and verifies the installer SHA-256 before launching it.
- Uses the existing safe-close path to stop F4 excitation before updating.
- Installs per-user under Local AppData; administrator rights are not required.
- F4 firmware is not included and was not changed.

Note: this installer is not yet code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may show a warning on first download.

releases.name: macOS signed update channel
releases.body:
Signed macOS update channel

Latest build: 2 (2.1.0-rc.5), Apple Silicon, minimum macOS 27.0. The signed feed includes exact full ZIPs for builds 1 and 2, plus the verified rc.4-to-rc.5 delta. Build 1 assets remain immutable and available.

For first installation use the DMG in v2.1.0-rc.5. For ST-Link factory HEX/USB firmware packages and bench-test limitations, see that release. This channel contains no Windows installer and is not the repository Latest release.
